_derived_from: yugi_pc.exe. Live tracing of every engine/AI function while a CPU duel was played (tools/poc_trace.py + data/duel_logs/yugi_duel_c_779_traced.txt) located the CPU-only code; Ghidra decompile (yugi_ai*.c) gives the logic. 'conf': seen = confirmed in trace/decompile, inferred = reading of the code not checked in play.
model: Rule-based script, no search or lookahead. Each CPU turn walks 7 fixed stages; each stage repeatedly issues one command and returns 'not done' until it has nothing left, then the next stage runs. Choices come from hard-coded priority lists with per-card conditions plus a 'simulate the board and score it' helper for monster plays.

entry.what: stage runner: calls stage[DAT_00a094f1] from the table at 0x5a33ac; a stage returning nonzero advances the index and clears the per-stage scratch bytes 0xa094f2..0xa094fa

stages.what: turn start: clears AI scratch, issues Main Phase 1 (op 0x52); if 0x579270 says nothing to do, jumps to the end

use cards from the 'first' list (0x594420): heal, burn, and spell/trap removal. Each card has a condition, e.g. burn/Ookazi only when the opponent is under ~1000 LP or the AI is ahead by 500 LP, removal only when the opponent has a set/face-up Spell or Trap. A matching card already Set is flipped (op 0x91); one in hand is activated or Set (op 0xc5).

Main Phase plan (sub-state 0xa094fa): 0 summon a monster, 2 activate face-up monster effects (list 0x5a33a0), 3 special combo step, 4 spell planner 0x576740, 10 normal summon/set from hand via 0x577090
for each of its 5 monster zones: decide Attack/Defense position and flip face-down monsters, using the comparator 0x5777c0 against the opponent's strongest monster
Battle Phase: if any monster can attack (0x567a80) and 0x574c90 finds a profitable attack, enter battle and run the attack executor 0x56b550

end of turn: Set Spell/Trap cards from hand (op 0xc5). Traps are always set; Spells are set only when useful as a set card, and some only when the opponent has a target (e.g. 0x3fb/0x3fe/0x402 check the opponent's field)

monster_choice.normal_summon: 0x577090 checks fixed priorities first: Sangan/Witch/Mystic Tomato in 'searcher' mode, then Man-Eater Bug, Hane-Hane and similar flip monsters when the opponent has monsters. Otherwise it picks the monster with the highest relevant stat (ATK if ATK > DEF, else DEF) that at least matches the opponent's best monster, then any level 1-4 monster.
monster_choice.tribute_summon: 0x574cc0 / 0x574f60 try each hand monster on a copy of the board, score the result with 0x574b80 and keep the best. Ties are broken by how many opponent monsters it out-classes.
monster_choice.tribute_pick: 0x572fc0: first a monster marked as tribute fodder by an effect (0x403 check), then Sangan, then Witch of the Black Forest, then the lowest DEF + 2*ATK. Some ids are never tributed in specific field states (0xa07470).
monster_choice.position: 0x5777c0(ATK, DEF) of the CPU monster vs oppBest = the opponent's highest ATK on the field. Returns 1 = Defense/face-down when: DEF > ATK and DEF > 1500 and DEF is at least the CPU's best ATK/DEF on the field; or ATK >= DEF but oppBest beats ATK by 1000 or more. Returns -1 (weaker than oppBest by under 1000, or DEF > ATK while the opponent has monsters) and 0 (no threat): the caller then plays it face-up in Attack. If the opponent has no monsters and the CPU field is full enough, always 0.

board_score.formula: On a saved copy of the board (0x5749d0/0x5749f0 save/restore), simulate the CPU's whole Battle Phase: attackers sorted by ATK ascending (except ids 0x226/0x2e8/0x2f9); each attacks directly if it can (score += ATK), else picks the target it beats with the largest margin (ties -> higher-DEF target). Attack-position target: damage = ATK - target ATK, target removed; defense target: removed if ATK > DEF, no damage. Score = total damage; it also counts monsters destroyed per side (bits of 0xa0b088) for tie-breaks.
board_score.quirk: a face-down defender's DEF is estimated as DEF * (turn + 5) / 20 while turn < 15 (turn = (0xa07470 >> 1) & 0x1f), so the CPU underestimates set monsters early in the duel

randomness.where: 0x5760d0 (spell activation): 'skip this activation' roll with CRT rand(): 1 in 8 normally, or 3 in 4 when AI flag bit0 is set, only while the opponent controls the card 0x405 (Magic Jammer)
randomness.note: the rest of the AI is deterministic for a given board. Card draws use the shuffle seeded by op 0x60
randomness.conf: seen in code; meaning of the condition inferred

ai_flags.addr: 0xa0e924 (u16, cleared at duel start 0x531b20, set through a struct copy; writer not found)
ai_flags.bit9 (0x200): 'searcher' mode: plays and tributes Sangan / Witch of the Black Forest / Mystic Tomato first
ai_flags.observed: hardware write-watch over 4 normal duel starts (tools/poc_watch.py): 0xa0e924 only ever written 0 (reset 0x531b20), 0xa0b08c only 0 (cleared every CPU turn by stage 0 via 0x536650 over 0xa09500..0xa0b090)
ai_flags.conclusion: normal CPU duels always run with flags 0 and no combo script; the flag bits and the 9 deck combo scripts belong to scripted modes (tutorial / demo / Kaiba trials) - inferred, the setter for those modes was not caught

not_yet_decoded: setter of the AI flags / strategy byte in scripted modes, and the card logic of the 9 combo scripts (only matter for tutorial/demo/trial duels)

deck_combo_scripts.dispatcher: 0x57a440 (not a Ghidra function; switch at 0x57a455, table 0x57a4c4)
deck_combo_scripts.selector: (DAT_00a0b08c >> 1) & 0x7f, values 0..8 = strategy of the CPU's deck; writer not found yet (likely loaded with the deck)
deck_combo_scripts.what: deck-specific combo plans (e.g. specific card pairs activated in order via 0x5760d0/0x572820); they then hand over to the normal 7-stage script (sets stage index 1)
deck_combo_scripts.conf: seen in code; none fired in the traced duel; per-routine card logic not decoded yet
deck_combo_scripts.used_in: not in normal duels (see ai_flags.observed); scripted modes only (inferred)

responses.where: response-window state machine 0x55f890 (state DAT_00a0c714). When the CPU is asked (state bit 0x1000), it jumps to state 200 (or state 100 = forward the question to a link-play opponent, message 0xf051, when DAT_00a0e920 byte1 bit0 is set).
responses.rule: state 200 scans the CPU's Spell/Trap zones 5..9 in order and activates the FIRST face-down card that (a) has spell speed >= 2 (Trap 2, Counter Trap 3, Quick-Play 2; 0x5484f0), (b) is legal now (0x55f170 -> card condition check 0x5485a0), and (c) passes the per-card approval 0x575100. Then state 201 flips it (op 0x91) and puts it on the chain. If none qualifies, it passes.
seen_in_play: duel A: Trap Hole on the human's summon
duel B: Spellbinding Circle on the human's attack declaration
duel B: Kuriboh discarded from hand during battle damage (separate hand-trap path)
duel C: none (CPU held no qualifying card)

approval_rules (0x575100).Two-Pronged Attack: only if the human has a face-up monster stronger than the CPU's best ATK/DEF
approval_rules (0x575100).Spellbinding Circle: on the human's turn, when the attacking monster is the human's strongest, or if the CPU already has one
approval_rules (0x575100).Ring of Destruction: if the target's ATK would finish the human (ATK > human LP) while the CPU survives it
approval_rules (0x575100).Reinforcements: when its battle would be lost by under 500 points and +500 turns it
approval_rules (0x575100).Just Desserts: if 500 x human monsters >= human LP (lethal), else random: rand()%3+1 < human monster count
approval_rules (0x575100).Magic Thorn: if the CPU holds Card Destruction or Delinquent Duo
approval_rules (0x575100).Mirror Force / Waboku: if the attack would deal damage >= CPU LP, or the CPU has no monsters and the human has 2+, or the attack total would kill / the CPU is behind
approval_rules (0x575100).Gift of The Mystical Elf: if there are 3+ monsters on the field in total
approval_rules (0x575100).Ceasefire: if 500 x effect monsters >= human LP, or the human has 2+ more effect monsters than the CPU
approval_rules (0x575100).Aqua Chorus: if the CPU has a face-up monster with a duplicate
approval_rules (0x575100).Magic Cylinder: if the attacker's ATK >= half of human LP, or >= CPU LP, or would take the CPU below 0, or the human has exactly 1 monster
approval_rules (0x575100).Torrential Tribute: if the human has any monster

responses.lp_addresses: player 0 LP u16 at 0xa07924, player 1 (CPU) LP at 0xa086bc (= +0xd98)
responses.conf: seen in code; three activations matched in recorded duels
